name: [🦖] 99 Nights in the Arctic 🧊
desc:
🔍 Search for “Arctic” to find this game easily! ❄️
🎉 Code: "X40KLIKEZ" | Next Code at 45k Likes! 🚀

A crash. A camp. And something spooky under the ice! ❄️
You and your friends have 99 nights to survive—stay warm, find food, and watch out for the scary thing in the dark!
Build your hut, keep the fire burning, and stick together… if you dare.

How long will you last?
